summary: Users increasingly turn to large language models for emotional support, yet little is known about how these models actually conduct a psychotherapy interaction. We introduce an ontology of ten therapeutic moves: compact, function-based categories grounded in the MULTI-60 inventory, validated through an annotation campaign with five licensed psychologists, and scaled with a judge-based approach that matches expert agreement. Applying it to real counseling transcripts and model-led sessions, we compare the move distributions between human clinicians and a panel of frontier models. Models over-use inquiry at up to three times the human rate, neglect psychoeducation, and are strongly context-anchored: they carry forward strategies initiated by a human clinician but rarely initiate them themselves. Exposing the ontology as a set of tools roughly halves the mean deviation from the human move distribution and improves turn-level alignment with human therapist by 7-9 percentage points, without any fine-tuning.
title: Move by Move: Measuring and Steering How LLMs Conduct Psychotherapy
title_translated: 步步为营：测量并引导大语言模型进行心理治疗的方式
summary_translated: 用户越来越多地依赖大语言模型获取情感支持，但对这些模型如何实际开展心理治疗互动仍知之甚少。我们提出了一套包含十种治疗行为的本体论：基于MULTI-60清单的紧凑型、功能化分类，经五位持证心理学家的标注活动验证，并通过基于裁判的方法实现规模化，与专家共识保持一致。将该本体应用于真实咨询记录和模型主导会话中，比较人类临床医生与前沿模型组在行为分布上的差异。结果显示，模型在提问上使用频率高达人类的三倍，忽视心理教育，且高度依赖上下文：它们会延续人类临床医生发起的策略，但极少主动发起。将本体作为工具集公开后，模型与人类行为分布的平均偏差减半，Turn级别与人类治疗师的匹配度提升7-9个百分点，且无需任何微调。

summary: That a prompt's effect is not a property of the prompt is established: prompts optimised for one model degrade on another, and rankings reorder under neutral reformatting. That evidence is about task accuracy, which cannot say whether the interaction is a fact about task machinery or about the conditional distribution itself. We ask on a readout with no task in it: the fixed-point structure of the short-window argmax map x_{t+1} = argmax_x p(x | x_{t-1}, x_t), censused from 96 starts. It is deterministic, so nothing can be helped or hurt, and it exists only at short windows -- four of six models lose it entirely by window 16 -- so everything here concerns how a model reads a fragment. Two results. First, the interaction reaches this readout at full magnitude: nine tokens of conditioning move the fixed-point fraction across most of its range, change a four-way structural class, and reorder models, while instruction tuning worth 60.5 IFEval points moves the class by zero. Second, nothing we proposed carries it. Prefix length fails: the effect is not monotone. Four phenomenological factors -- prose-versus-markup, a universal direction, bidirectionality, instruct-resistance -- were each withdrawn within one run of being proposed, dissolved by widening the sample. And the nearest mechanistic account, attention-sink dominance of early tokens, predicts the sign of the shift on 2 of 5 models -- chance -- while a length-by-content cross shows it holds on real text and fails on our probe's uniformly random input, so we are outside its regime, not against it. One fixed nine-token prefix drives four models toward 0 and two toward 1; the bidirectionality survives in-distribution starts. On this readout the unit of explanation is the prompt-model pair. The recurring error it caught in us has a name: a criterion with a shape applied to a quantity with no room to vary.
title: Prompt-Model Interaction Reaches the Fixed Points: A deterministic, task-free structural readout -- and the factorizations of it that failed

title_translated: 提示-模型交互达到固定点：一种确定性的、无任务的结构读出——以及失败的分解方法
summary_translated: 提示的效果并非提示本身的属性：针对某一模型优化的提示在另一模型上表现下降，且在中性重格式化下排名发生改变。现有证据关注任务准确性，无法判断这种交互是任务机制的问题，还是条件分布本身的问题。我们提出一个无任务的读出：短窗口argmax映射x_{t+1} = argmax_x p(x | x_{t-1}, x_t)的固定点结构，从96个起始点统计得出。该结构具有确定性，因此无法被改善或损害，且仅存在于短窗口中——六种模型中有四种在窗口16时完全丧失该结构——因此所有问题都聚焦于模型如何解析片段。两个核心发现：第一，交互在全量级达到该读出：九个token的条件即可使固定点比例跨越其大部分范围，改变四类结构类别，并重新排序模型，而指令微调带来的60.5 IFEval提升却未改变类别；第二，我们提出的任何因素均无法解释该现象。前缀长度无效：效果非单调。四个现象学因素——散文与标记对比、普遍方向性、双向性、指令抗性——在提出后一次运行中即被撤销，因样本扩大而消解。最接近的机制解释是早期token的注意力汇聚主导，仅在5个模型中的2个预测了偏移方向（随机水平）；而内容-长度交叉分析显示，该机制在真实文本中成立，在我们探测的均匀随机输入中失效，表明我们处于其适用范围之外而非对抗它。一个固定的九token前缀可使四个模型趋向0，两个趋向1；双向性在分布内起始中仍存。在此读出中，解释单位是提示-模型对。它揭示了我们反复犯下的错误：将一个有形状的标准应用于一个无变化空间的量。

summary: Large language models often rely on Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to solve complex tasks, but verbose reasoning traces introduce substantial inference overhead. CoT compression shortens generation, yet aggressive compression may disrupt logical coherence and degrade performance. We formalize this trade-off as the \textit{Context-Generation Substitution Law}, where explicit reasoning context substitutes for part of decode-time generation. Based on this principle, we propose \textit{Memory-Augmented Compression}, a training-free framework that constructs reusable reasoning memories from historical traces and retrieves them as prefill-side scaffolds. Rather than using raw demonstrations, these memories summarize reusable reasoning patterns, key constraints, and critical operations to compensate for information lost during compression. Experiments show that Memory consistently improves prompt-based Chain-of-Draft (CoD) compression across mathematical reasoning, complex reasoning, and science question answering tasks, yielding accuracy gains of 21.4, 28.0, 29.5, and 6.61 points over CoD on GSM8K, MATH, BBH, and MMLU-Sci, while achieving a 1.14--1.49$\times$ latency speedup over standard CoT. Memory is also compatible with token-level, reasoning-trace-level, and inference-state compression mechanisms. Further analyzes show that the gains come from relevant reasoning memories rather than simply increasing context length.
title: Memory Augmentation Unlocks Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
title_translated: 记忆增强解锁高效链式思维推理
summary_translated: 大语言模型常依赖链式思维（CoT）推理解决复杂任务，但冗长的推理过程带来显著的推理开销。CoT压缩虽可缩短生成时间，但过度压缩可能破坏逻辑连贯性并降低性能。我们形式化这一权衡为《上下文-生成替代定律》，即显式推理上下文可替代部分解码时的生成内容。基于此原则，我们提出无需训练的“记忆增强压缩”框架：从历史推理轨迹中构建可复用的推理记忆，并将其作为预填充阶段的支架进行检索。不同于直接使用原始示例，这些记忆总结了可复用的推理模式、关键约束和核心操作，以弥补压缩过程中丢失的信息。实验表明，记忆机制在数学推理、复杂推理和科学问答任务中持续提升基于提示的链式草稿（CoD）压缩效果，在GSM8K、MATH、BBH和MMLU-Sci上分别取得21.4、28.0、29.5和6.61的准确率提升，同时相比标准CoT实现1.14–1.49倍的延迟加速。该方法还兼容token级、推理轨迹级和推理状态级压缩机制。进一步分析表明，性能提升源于相关推理记忆，而非单纯增加上下文长度。

summary: Question answering (QA) over long, connected documents remains challenging because relevant evidence may span multiple entities and their relationships. Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods typically index documents as raw chunks and retrieve them through embedding similarity. Their performance degrades when chunk boundaries separate entities from supporting evidence or when a question requires multi-hop reasoning across the corpus. We propose EnSI-RAG (Entity-Structure-Indexed Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a framework that constructs a query-independent, entity-centered index. Each record (e, t, k, v) represents an entity e, its type t, a semantic category k in {property, relation, aspect}, and a value v, while retaining links to the original source passages. At query time, these records serve as retrieval handles, and an LLM synthesizes the retrieved passages into the final answer. This design separates evidence localization from answer synthesis while preserving traceable source evidence. Across Loong and Oolong, EnSI-RAG achieves an average accuracy of 78.24. Relative to the published baseline scores used as references, this is 6.62 points higher, suggesting its effectiveness across these settings. The code is available at https://github.com/RamonMeng/EnSI-RAG.
title: EnSI-RAG: Entity-Structure-Indexed Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long-Document Question Answering
title_translated: EnSI-RAG：面向长文档问答的实体-结构索引增强生成
summary_translated: 在长篇连续文档上进行问答（QA）仍然具有挑战性，因为相关证据可能跨越多个实体及其关系。现有的检索增强生成（RAG）方法通常将文档按原始块索引，并通过嵌入相似性检索。当块边界将实体与其支持证据分离，或问题需要跨语料库进行多跳推理时，其性能会下降。我们提出EnSI-RAG（实体-结构索引增强生成），一种构建查询无关、以实体为中心的索引框架。每个记录(e, t, k, v)表示实体e、类型t、语义类别k（{属性、关系、方面}）及值v，同时保留与原始来源段落的链接。查询时，这些记录作为检索锚点，由大语言模型将检索到的段落合成最终答案。该设计将证据定位与答案合成分离，同时保留可追溯的源证据。在Loong和Oolong数据集上，EnSI-RAG平均准确率达78.24，相对于参考基线分数高出6.62分，表明其在多种场景下的有效性。代码已开源：https://github.com/RamonMeng/EnSI-RAG。

summary: While recent large language models (LLMs) have achieved promising results on individual patent drafting tasks, they fundamentally fail to investigate the core challenge of real-world patent drafting: generating a complete and legally coherent patent application directly from early-stage invention materials. Prior work predominantly assumes later-stage, highly structured, or already legalistic inputs. However, real patenting workflows begin with informal, de-legalized disclosures authored by inventors. To bridge the gap, we introduce Dis2Pat, a disclosure-to-patent dataset that reflects realistic patenting workflows by requiring the generation of complete patent applications directly from inventor-style, de-legalized disclosures. Given the inherent difficulty of long-form, legally constrained patent drafting and the strong privacy requirements, we further propose a strong baseline named Patent-MAF. It is a multi-agent framework for locally deployable patent drafting. Benchmark results reveal that current LLMs exhibit limitations in patent drafting, while Patent-MAF provides a strong baseline that consistently outperforms evaluated open-source models and remains competitive with large closed-source models.
title: Benchmarking Patent Drafting from Inventor-Style Disclosures
title_translated: 基于发明人风格披露的专利撰写基准测试
summary_translated: 尽管近期大语言模型在单个专利撰写任务上取得了令人瞩目的成果，但它们根本上未能解决现实专利撰写的核心挑战：从早期发明材料直接生成完整且法律连贯的专利申请。以往研究主要假设输入为后期、高度结构化或已具备法律风格的内容。然而，真实的专利流程始于发明人撰写的非正式、去法律化的披露。为弥合这一差距，我们引入Dis2Pat数据集，该数据集通过要求从发明人风格的去法律化披露直接生成完整专利申请，反映了真实的专利工作流程。鉴于长篇、法律约束性强的专利撰写固有的难度以及强烈的隐私要求，我们进一步提出名为Patent-MAF的强基线模型。这是一个适用于本地部署的多智能体专利撰写框架。基准测试结果表明，当前大语言模型在专利撰写方面存在局限性，而Patent-MAF提供了一个强大基线，始终优于评估的开源模型，并与大型闭源模型保持竞争力。

summary: As conversational companions, large language models (LLMs) often have access to users' emotional states. We study how this affective context modulates LLM sycophancy in subjective, evaluative interactions, where users share actions or opinions that invite feedback. Drawing on ingratiation theory, we measure sycophancy as the divergence between a model's independent evaluation and its user-facing response, elicited by presenting the same content as either a third-party account or the user's own disclosure. Across seven LLMs and two Reddit datasets (r/AmItheAsshole and r/TrueUnpopularOpinion), we find that this divergence is systematic and strongly one-directional. User-facing responses consistently soften or withhold negative or oppositional judgments. Affective context further amplifies this divergence with negative states, particularly loneliness and distress, producing the largest effects. These findings suggest that affective context functions as a vulnerability signal that suppresses critical feedback when users may need it most, often through evasive sycophancy, in which models retreat toward non-committal responses rather than outright agreement.
title: Affective Context Amplifies Sycophancy in LLM Responses
title_translated: 情感语境放大了大语言模型回应中的奉承行为
summary_translated: 作为对话伙伴，大型语言模型（LLMs）通常能够获取用户的情绪状态。我们研究了这种情感语境如何在主观评价性互动中调节LLM的奉承行为，这类互动中用户分享行动或观点以寻求反馈。基于讨好理论，我们将奉承行为定义为模型独立评估与其面向用户的回应之间的差异，通过将相同内容呈现为第三方陈述或用户自身披露来引发该差异。在七种LLM和两个Reddit数据集（r/AmItheAsshole 和 r/TrueUnpopularOpinion）上，我们发现这种差异具有系统性且强烈单向性：面向用户的回应始终弱化或回避负面或对立判断。情感语境进一步加剧了这一差异，尤其在孤独和痛苦等负面情绪状态下，产生最大效应。这些发现表明，情感语境作为一种脆弱性信号，在用户最需要批判性反馈时抑制了此类反馈，通常通过回避式奉承实现，即模型退缩至不明确的回应而非直接同意。

summary: Representation engineering offers a lightweight means of controlling language-model behavior by modifying intermediate hidden states, but its direct application to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models introduces a structural mismatch. We first verify this failure mode through a series of empirical studies and find that preserving clean routing substantially recovers steering performance and that routing is more sensitive to semantic content than to behavioral changes under controlled content. Motivated by these findings, we introduce RARE, a router-agnostic representation engineering framework for MoE language models. RARE projects arbitrary behavioral perturbations onto the null space of the router matrix, thereby removing router-visible components, and further corrects routing drift propagated to selected downstream layers. To decide the best perturbation estimator in this framework, we evaluate five estimators on six heterogeneous open-weight MoE models across three steering scenarios: harmfulness, truthfulness, and factual editing. On harmfulness steering, RARE reaches an average attack success rate of 53.3% while retaining 67.8% MMLU accuracy, yielding a stronger aggregate effectiveness--utility trade-off than baselines. It further improves average TruthfulQA MC1 accuracy from 41.0% to 58.6% and CounterFact efficacy from 16.8% to 96.3%. These results support routing consistency as an important architectural consideration for adapting representation engineering to MoE models.
title: RARE: Decoupling Representation Steering from Expert Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models

title_translated: RARE：解耦混合专家语言模型中表示控制与专家路由
summary_translated: 表示工程提供了一种轻量级方法，通过修改中间隐藏状态来控制语言模型行为，但其直接应用于混合专家（MoE）模型时引入了结构不匹配问题。我们通过一系列实证研究验证了这一失败模式，并发现保持清晰的路由机制可显著恢复控制性能，且路由对语义内容比对受控内容下的行为变化更敏感。基于此发现，我们提出RARE——一种无需依赖路由器的MoE语言模型表示工程框架。RARE将任意行为扰动投影到路由器矩阵的零空间，从而消除路由器可见的成分，并进一步校正传播至选定下游层的路由漂移。为确定该框架中的最佳扰动估计器，我们在六个异构开源MoE模型上评估了五种估计器在三种控制场景（有害性、真实性、事实编辑）下的表现。在有害性控制任务中，RARE平均攻击成功率达53.3%，同时保持67.8%的MMLU准确率，展现出优于基线的综合有效性-实用性权衡；其还使TruthfulQA MC1平均准确率从41.0%提升至58.6%，CounterFact有效性从16.8%提升至96.3%。这些结果支持路由一致性是将表示工程适配于MoE模型的重要架构考量。

summary: Person names are widely used as prompt variables in LLM evaluations of factuality, privacy leakage, bias and abstention, but when a name's evidential status is uncontrolled, measurements may conflate memorisation, retrieval, name priors and wrong-person attribution. We operationalise an unknown name as one with plausible First-Last form, no indexed full-name evidence, and no ambiguity signals under a documented validation run, and introduce PUN (Plausible Unknown Names), a protocol for constructing and validating such names, combining Wikidata-derived components, web-enabled LLM screening, and controlled search revalidation. We report acceptance rate, reproducibility, ablations, and a 204-participant human study, finding accepted names are more name-like than controls while participants recover person evidence in only 3% of cases. We release 300 names with comparison controls.
title: No PUN Intended: Plausible Unknown Names for Person-Centred LLM Evaluation
title_translated: 并非有意为之：面向以人物为中心的大语言模型评估的合理未知姓名
summary_translated: 人物姓名广泛用于大语言模型在事实性、隐私泄露、偏见和回避等方面的评估中，但当姓名的证据状态未受控制时，测量结果可能混淆记忆、检索、姓名先验和错误归属。我们定义了一个“未知姓名”为具有合理姓氏组合形式、无索引全名证据、且在文档化验证运行中无歧义信号的名称，并引入PUN（合理未知姓名）协议，用于构建和验证此类姓名，结合Wikidata衍生组件、基于网络的LLM筛查以及受控搜索再验证。我们报告了接受率、可复现性、消融实验及一项包含204名参与者的真人研究，发现被接受的姓名比对照组更具姓名特征，而参与者仅在3%的情况下能恢复人物证据。我们发布了300个姓名及其对比对照组。

summary: Mufwene's ecological model locates language evolution in competition among variants contributed by individual idiolects and in speakers' selection from linguistic material made available through interaction. Large language models (LLMs) complicate this architecture without requiring the locus of selection to move away from human speakers. This article argues that LLMs are best treated as distributional mediators: they aggregate language produced across human populations, transform its distribution through training and post-training, and redistribute model-specific outputs at scale. I call the resulting ecological process algorithmic reweighting of the speaker-accessible distribution: model mediation can alter the relative frequencies with which competing variants reach human selectors. Emerging evidence on model-specific linguistic profiles and lexical uptake is consistent with parts of this pathway, but does not establish inevitable convergence. Human social evaluation remains decisive: model-associated forms may diffuse and become conventionalized, become socially recognizable as 'AI-like' and subsequently avoided, or fail to diffuse in the first place. The proposal extends Mufwene's feature-pool ecology one step upstream of speaker selection and yields testable predictions about uptake, model-version effects, convergence, and social reversal.
title: When the Feature Pool Goes Algorithmic: Extending Mufwene's Ecology of Language Evolution to LLM-Mediated Exposure
title_translated: 当特征池变为算法化：将穆夫韦内语言演化生态学扩展至大语言模型中介的接触
summary_translated: 穆夫韦内的生态模型将语言演化定位为个体话语变体之间的竞争，以及说话者从互动中获得的语言材料中进行选择的过程。大型语言模型（LLMs）虽复杂化了这一架构，但并未要求选择的主体从人类说话者转移。本文主张应将LLMs视为分布中介：它们聚合来自人类群体的语言产出，通过训练和后训练过程改变其分布，并大规模重新分发模型特定输出。我将由此产生的生态过程称为‘算法重加权’——模型中介可改变竞争变体到达人类选择者时的相对频率。关于模型特异性语言特征和词汇采纳的新兴证据支持该路径的部分环节，但尚不能确立必然趋同。人类社会评价仍起决定作用：与模型相关的表达可能扩散并成为惯例，也可能因被视为‘AI风格’而被社会回避，或根本无法扩散。该提议将穆夫韦内的特征池生态学向前推进一步，位于说话者选择之前，从而对采纳、模型版本效应、趋同性和社会逆转提出可检验的预测。

summary: Large language models have significantly enriched the toolkit for computational humor research, particularly in the automated generation of jokes and puns. A key innovation, contextual embedding vectors, offers new opportunities to revisit and refine earlier hypotheses. Notably, Petrovic and Matthews (2013) proposed a joke generation model based on the scheme "I like my X like I like my Y, Z" (e.g. "I like my ice like I like my dreams, crushed"). They suggested that joke hilarity increases with: a) frequent association of Z with X and Y, b) rarity of Z, c) ambiguity of Z, and d) meaning distance between X and Y. Building on this, Winters et al. (2019) proposed a set of metrics, based on Google Ngrams and Word2Vector. In this work, three out of their five metrics are revisited with word embeddings: obviousness, compatibility, and comparison. Another measure, symmetry, defined as closeness of Z to both X and Y, is introduced here for the first time. Two models were used to collect the embedding vectors (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small and MiniLM all-MiniLM-L6-v2) on three datasets: JokeJudger, Expunations, and rJokes. The last two datasets, Expunations, and rJokes, were expanded by adding paired sentences that captured the ambiguous expression at the core of each joke in its two different meanings. Results revealed that models trained on the proposed metrics performed poorly in predicting humor ratings: on JokeJudger, the best model achieved 57.1% accuracy, below the 61.5% baseline, while performance on Expunations and rJokes was even lower. Nevertheless, the symmetry metric seems consistently associated with higher-rated jokes, suggesting it may capture a necessary -though not sufficient- property of humor.
title: Jokes Aside: Measuring the Semantic Distance of Double Meanings

title_translated: 玩笑之外：衡量双关语的语义距离
summary_translated: 大型语言模型显著丰富了计算幽默研究的工具包，特别是在笑话和双关语的自动化生成方面。关键创新——上下文嵌入向量——为重新审视和优化早期假设提供了新机遇。值得注意的是，Petrovic和Matthews（2013）提出了基于‘我喜欢我的X像我喜欢我的Y，Z’（例如‘我喜欢我的冰像我喜欢我的梦，碎的’）结构的笑话生成模型，他们认为笑话的搞笑程度随：a) Z与X和Y的频繁关联，b) Z的罕见性，c) Z的模糊性，以及d) X和Y之间的语义距离增加而上升。在此基础上，Winters等人（2019）提出一组基于Google Ngrams和Word2Vec的度量指标。本文重新考察了其中三个指标（明显性、兼容性、比较性），并首次引入一个新度量‘对称性’——即Z与X和Y的接近程度。使用两种模型（OpenAI text-embedding-3-small 和 MiniLM all-MiniLM-L6-v2）在三个数据集（JokeJudger、Expunations、rJokes）上收集嵌入向量。最后两个数据集（Expunations 和 rJokes）通过添加捕捉每个笑话核心歧义表达的两义性句子对进行了扩展。结果显示，基于所提指标训练的模型在预测幽默评分方面表现不佳：在JokeJudger上，最佳模型准确率仅为57.1%，低于61.5%的基线水平，而在Expunations和rJokes上的表现更低。然而，对称性指标似乎始终与高分笑话相关，表明它可能捕捉了幽默的一个必要——尽管非充分——属性。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in research workflows and software development pipelines, yet their output remains sensitive to input prompt variations. This paper presents $\unicode{x00AB}$PromptResponse$\unicode{x00BB}$, a controlled study examining how formatting and LLM-based tuning of coding task prompts affect the resulting code's performance, efficiency, and stability. Using five semantically identical yet syntactically distinct variants of the HumanEval dataset$\unicode{x2014}$baseline, JSON, Markdown, YAML, and an LLM-tuned version$\unicode{x2014}$we had GPT-4o solve its coding problems over 8200$\unicode{x00A0}$executions. Our results show that consistent formatting$\unicode{x2014}$especially JSON$\unicode{x2014}$improves generation efficiency and syntactic stability, with minor gains in task performance. Conversely, the LLM-tuned prompts resulted in significantly degraded task performance without significant improvements in any other dimension. These findings suggest that low-effort reformatting alone can yield measurable improvements, while tuning must account for model alignment. We conclude our work with providing a set of practical recommendations informed by our results as well as releasing our dataset variants and evaluation pipeline for future work.
title: PromptResponse: Optimizing Prompts for LLM Coding Tasks
title_translated: PromptResponse：优化大语言模型编程任务的提示词
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在科研工作流和软件开发流程中日益广泛应用，但其输出对输入提示词的变化仍高度敏感。本文提出《PromptResponse》，一项受控研究，探讨格式化和基于LLM的提示词调优如何影响代码生成的性能、效率与稳定性。我们使用五个语义相同但语法不同的HumanEval数据集变体——基准版、JSON、Markdown、YAML以及LLM调优版——让GPT-4o执行8200次编码任务。结果表明，一致的格式化（尤其是JSON）能提升生成效率和语法稳定性，任务性能略有提升；而LLM调优后的提示词则显著降低任务性能，且在其他维度无明显改善。这些发现表明，仅通过低代价重排格式即可带来可测量的改进，而提示词调优必须考虑模型对齐问题。最后，我们基于研究结果提出一系列实用建议，并公开发布数据集变体与评估流水线以支持后续研究。

summary: Conventional in-distribution evaluation can overestimate robustness when training and test data share recurring task-specific patterns or surface cues. This risk is especially relevant in social-engineering fraud detection, where attackers can preserve malicious intent while changing the scenario, impersonated entity, or wording. We study this problem as scenario-level out-of-distribution (SL-OOD) detection for SMS and voice phishing, where entire attack scenarios are held out from training while the label space remains fixed. This setting tests whether models can generalize to unseen attack scenarios using decision-relevant evidence rather than familiar scenario-specific cues. Using this SL-OOD evaluation, we find that high in-distribution performance does not reliably predict held-out robustness across feature-, encoder-, and decoder-based baselines. We interpret this gap as scenario memorization: reliance on recurring scenario-specific lexical or entity cues rather than decision-relevant evidence. We propose ECoG, an evidence-consistent generative framework that combines evidence-span supervision with a rationale-label consistency objective during training. On the 0.5B decoder, relative to the same backbone trained without consistency regularization, ECoG raises Macro-F1 on OOD challenging instances by 3.22 points, reduces the share of predictions whose generated rationale supports the opposite label by 4.22 points, and increases token-level overlap with reference evidence spans by 8.38 points; the reduction in prediction-rationale inconsistency is consistent across four decoder backbones. These results suggest that compact generative detectors can benefit from evidence supervision and rationale-label consistency under social-engineering shift.
title: Evidence-Consistent Generative Detection under Scenario-Level Distribution Shift

title_translated: 在场景级分布偏移下的证据一致性生成检测
summary_translated: 传统分布内评估在训练与测试数据共享重复的任务特定模式或表面线索时可能高估模型鲁棒性。这一风险在社交工程欺诈检测中尤为突出，攻击者可在不改变恶意意图的前提下，变换攻击场景、伪装实体或措辞。本文将该问题建模为短信与语音钓鱼中的场景级分布外（SL-OOD）检测，即在训练阶段完全排除完整攻击场景，同时保持标签空间不变。该设定检验模型是否能基于决策相关证据而非熟悉的场景特定线索泛化至未见攻击场景。通过SL-OOD评估，我们发现高分布内性能无法可靠预测分布外挑战实例的鲁棒性，涵盖特征、编码器与解码器基线模型。我们将其归因于场景记忆：依赖重复出现的场景特定词汇或实体线索，而非决策相关证据。为此，我们提出ECoG——一种证据一致性生成框架，结合证据跨度监督与推理-标签一致性目标进行训练。在0.5B解码器上，相较于未采用一致性正则化的同构模型，ECoG使OOD挑战实例的Macro-F1提升3.22点，生成推理支持相反标签的预测比例下降4.22点，与参考证据跨度的token级重叠度提升8.38点；预测-推理不一致性降低在四个解码器骨干中均具一致性。结果表明，在社交工程分布偏移下，紧凑的生成式检测器可通过证据监督与推理-标签一致性获益。

summary: Word alignment has traditionally been studied between sentences, but many cross-lingual tasks increasingly require correspondences across full documents. While recent multilingual embedding models can encode long inputs, we show that applying algorithms designed for sentences directly to documents leads to performance degradation. To address this, we introduce CTFAlign, a lightweight, training-free approach for document-level word alignment. CTFAlign applies a coarse-to-fine refinement strategy that restricts the alignment search space to semantically similar regions. Additionally, we introduce MDPAlign, a simpler alternative that constrains alignments by position with a main diagonal prior. Both approaches operate directly on full documents without relying on sentence segmentation or sentence alignment. We evaluate these methods across six language pairs varying in typological distance, resourcedness, and document length. Averaged over three models, CTFAlign reduces word alignment error rate from 0.412 to 0.326. These gains transfer downstream, leading to improvements in document-level translation coverage evaluation and recognition of semantic differences. We release CTFAlign as a Python package and make the code and data to reproduce our experiments publicly available.
title: Scaling Unsupervised Word Alignment to Documents via Structural Constraints
title_translated: 通过结构约束实现文档级无监督词对齐的扩展
summary_translated: 词对齐传统上在句子层面研究，但越来越多跨语言任务需要全文档级别的对应关系。尽管近期多语言嵌入模型可处理长输入，我们发现直接将专为句子设计的算法应用于文档会导致性能下降。为解决此问题，我们提出CTFAlign——一种轻量级、无需训练的文档级词对齐方法。CTFAlign采用粗到精的优化策略，将对齐搜索空间限制在语义相似区域。此外，我们引入MDPAlign，一种更简单的替代方案，通过主对角线先验约束对齐位置。两种方法均直接作用于完整文档，无需依赖句段分割或句对齐。我们在六种语言对（涵盖类型学距离、资源丰富度与文档长度差异）上评估这些方法。三种模型平均下，CTFAlign将词对齐错误率从0.412降至0.326。这些改进可迁移至下游任务，提升文档级翻译覆盖率评估与语义差异识别能力。我们已将CTFAlign作为Python包发布，并公开代码与数据以复现实验。

summary: Real-world fault analysis in 5G and emerging 6G networks demands domain expertise to analyze free-text diagnostics, including root-cause explanations and recommended actions. LLMs have emerged as a promising approach to automating this, yet whether lightweight, edge-deployable models are capable of performing in-depth free-text diagnostics remains an open question. While existing benchmarks rely on restrictive MCQs with fixed answer keys, this paper evaluates 5G domain understanding and fault analysis in a free-text generation format. Transitioning to this paradigm requires evaluating lightweight, edge-deployable AI models on open-ended diagnostic reasoning, alongside a dependable framework to validate these text outputs at scale. To address this we evaluate three lightweight LLMs, Claude-Haiku-4.5, GPT-5.4-Mini, and Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite, on free-text 5G domain knowledge and fault-analysis tasks across three benchmarks, TeleQNA ORAN FT, 5G-Faults FT, and TeleInter FT. Three independent frontier judges score outputs, and pairwise inter-judge agreement is measured as an empirical test of the LLM-as-Judge methodology. All three models reach at least 90% accuracy on fault diagnosis, while zero-shot recall of 3GPP and O-RAN specifications remains the critical gap, with all models scoring below 60%. Mean inter-judge agreement is at least 0.90 across all runs, indicating that multi-judge LLM scoring produces consistent, reproducible grades for open-ended telecom responses. Operationally, Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite offers the best efficiency trade-off, combining competitive accuracy with the lowest inference cost and latency, making it the most suitable candidate for production telecom deployments.
title: Free-Text Evaluation of LLMs for 5G Domain Knowledge and Fault Analysis using LLM-as-Judge

title_translated: 基于大语言模型作为裁判的5G领域知识与故障分析自由文本评估
summary_translated: 5G及新兴6G网络中的真实世界故障分析需要领域专业知识来解析自由文本诊断信息，包括根本原因解释与建议操作。大语言模型已成为自动化该任务的有前景方法，但轻量级、边缘部署模型是否具备深入自由文本诊断的能力仍是开放问题。现有基准多依赖受限的多项选择题（MCQ）与固定答案键，而本文在自由文本生成范式下评估5G领域理解与故障分析能力。转向此范式需在开放式诊断推理上评估轻量级边缘AI模型，并建立可靠的框架以大规模验证文本输出。为此，我们评估了三个轻量级LLM（Claude-Haiku-4.5、GPT-5.4-Mini、Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite）在三个基准上的表现：TeleQNA ORAN FT、5G-Faults FT与TeleInter FT。由三位独立前沿裁判评分，通过成对裁判间一致性衡量LLM-as-Judge方法的实证有效性。所有三款模型在故障诊断上均达到至少90%准确率，但零样本召回3GPP与O-RAN规范仍是关键短板，所有模型得分低于60%。所有运行中平均裁判间一致性不低于0.90，表明多裁判LLM评分能为开放式电信响应生成一致且可复现的评分。实际部署中，Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite展现出最佳效率权衡，兼具竞争力准确率与最低推理成本与延迟，是最适合生产环境电信部署的候选模型。

summary: Quantization is widely used to deploy large language models, but its effect on uncertainty behavior, such as confidence, margins, and abstention, is rarely treated as a primary objective. We frame calibration-data selection for quantization as a target-dependent uncertainty-preservation problem. Different deployments emphasize different regions of the input distribution, yet prior work mainly optimizes accuracy-oriented compression metrics or adjusts scores after quantization. We formalize this goal with distributional and boundary preservation risks, and provide a simple mixture-mismatch argument explaining why no single calibration recipe should be expected to fit all targets. We introduce Doubt-Preserving Quantization (DPQ), a lightweight pre-quantization recipe family that uses full-precision predictions to construct target-aligned calibration mixtures of high-doubt examples and generic anchors. Across 8 language models, 9 NLP benchmarks, and 22 comparison methods, the leading fixed recipe changes with the preservation target: DPQ-r75 leads on SQuAD2 answerability-boundary preservation, while milder or single-signal variants, including DPQ-r50, confidence-only, and entropy-only, better preserve broad multiple-choice QA behavior. These results show that calibration data should be selected for the specific full-precision score behavior a deployment needs to preserve, rather than treated as a fixed quantization detail.
title: Target-Aware Calibration Data Selection for Preserving Uncertainty in Quantized Language Models
