title_translated: 校准LLM智能体中的标准修订：失败模式与一种基于追踪的协议
summary_translated: 语言模型智能体可在失败后改进，或在跨轮次中传递文本而不修订成功标准。我们研究更狭窄的归因问题：当标准K0接受一个违反更广泛承诺B的结果时，哪些观察可证明系统形成了并持续使用了新标准K1？我们提出五个非补偿性条件：标准失败检测、模型生成的提议、新轮次转移、对声称载体的干预敏感性以及保持性。我们在CMB-0.1上评估了十二个跨领域案例和四个实验分支：无状态推理、追加式历史、模型生成但受约束状态、评估者编写的预言状态。七种机制修复产生84次确定性评分试验；四种局部量化伪影产生96次调用和192次模型-案例-分支试验。没有任何模型试验满足全部五个条件，但此零结果并不意味着普遍能力缺失。十一处调用在重试一次后仍无效；若干承诺揭示了目标区分；测试工具执行了提交；删除操作复用了无状态调用；冲突改变了多个因素。Qwen2.5-7B在无修订状态的情况下回答了所有转移与保持项，暴露了零状态重构问题。这些失败使CMB-0.1成为仪器校准结果，而非模型排名工具。我们推导出一种前瞻性、基于追踪的CMB-0.4协议，要求隐藏转移、明确的WRITE/NO-WRITE/ESCALATE动作、独立记录的策略选择提交、匹配的干预、重复隐藏项以及冻结的可执行预言。这是一个后续设计，而非已完成的确认性结果。本文贡献包括一条测量链、对其首次实现的实证诊断，以及未来测试标准修订的更具区分力的协议。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has no model of time: when a fact changes across a coding session - a function is renamed, an endpoint moves, a dependency is bumped - RAG retrieves both the old and new value with near-identical similarity and cannot tell which is current, so it serves the superseded value. Paper 1 showed, on synthetic single-value benchmarks, that a deterministic (subject, relation, object) supersession memory eliminates this failure. Here we validate it end-to-end on real software history. From 707 real GitHub issues (SWE-bench Lite + Verified) we extract 130 clean atomic state transitions, a fix that changes one identifiable value from a pre-fix to a post-fix form, and render each marker-free (the stale and current statements differ only in the value). On this set, MemStrata reaches 0.91 answer accuracy versus RAG's 0.57-0.59; and, the structural result, when forced to answer RAG serves the superseded value 36-38% of the time (an LLM reranker does not help) while MemStrata drives this to ~0, at RAG retrieval latency (~2.1 s vs ~18 s for the reranker). We are explicit about scope: only ~18% of real fixes are clean atomic transitions; Paper 2 isolates the memory mechanism on that class, and extraction coverage of the remaining fixes is the orthogonal problem we defer to follow-on work. A real product bug surfaced and was fixed during the study (a case/punctuation-insensitive value comparison), with the moat property (deterministic-supersession accuracy on clean code mutations) preserved and verified.
title: Temporal Validity on Real Software Histories: Eliminating Stale-Fact Errors in Code-Assistant Memory over GitHub Fixes
title_translated: 真实软件历史中的时间有效性：在GitHub修复中消除代码助手记忆中的过时事实错误
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）缺乏时间模型：当代码会话中某个事实发生变化——函数重命名、端点迁移、依赖项升级——RAG会以几乎相同的相似度检索旧值和新值，无法判断哪个是当前值，因此会提供已被取代的旧值。论文1在合成单值基准上表明，确定性（主体，关系，对象）的覆盖记忆机制可消除这一失败。本文在真实软件历史中对这一机制进行了端到端验证。从707个真实的GitHub问题（SWE-bench Lite + Verified）中提取出130个干净的原子状态转换（即仅改变一个可识别值的修复），并去除标记（过时和当前陈述仅在值上不同）。在此数据集上，MemStrata的答案准确率达到0.91，而RAG仅为0.57-0.59；结构化结果显示，强制RAG回答时，其有36-38%的时间会提供被取代的值（即使使用LLM重排序器也无改善），而MemStrata将该比例降至约0，且保持了RAG的检索延迟（约2.1秒 vs 重排序器的约18秒）。我们明确指出研究范围：仅有约18%的真实修复属于干净的原子转换；论文2专门针对该类修复隔离了记忆机制，其余修复的提取覆盖率是后续工作需解决的独立问题。研究期间发现并修复了一个真实产品缺陷（大小写/标点不敏感的值比较），同时验证了“确定性覆盖准确性”这一关键属性得以保留。

summary: Many agentic systems must repeatedly choose between acting and abstaining, making faithful reasoning important for oversight: an explanation is useful only if it reflects the computation that produced the action. We study this problem through intervention timing in multi-party conversation, where an assistant must decide whether to speak or remain silent. This setting exposes class imbalance, asymmetric action costs, and the possibility that exposing reasoning changes the policy being audited. Using Qwen3-8B, decoded with or without chain-of-thought reasoning, we compare direct decision policies, reasoning policies, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning. We find a capability-auditability tradeoff: the strongest direct policy achieves higher quality but exposes no reasoning to inspect, while the reasoning policy provides a trace at the cost of lower performance, particularly recall of true intervention opportunities. Supervised fine-tuning either suppresses reasoning or preserves it without improving decision quality, while reinforcement learning also fails to improve the reasoning policy. We identify one mechanism underlying this failure: group relative objectives provide no learning signal on confidently wrong prompts when sampled rollouts all select the same action. Controlled activation probes and behavioral ablations show that standard faithfulness methods can overstate evidence that exposed reasoning reflects the underlying decision process. Probability-based metrics saturate under confident decisions, probes are vulnerable to class imbalance and textual leakage, and reasoning ablations can confound reasoning content with changes in inference mode. Together, these results show that exposing reasoning can change an agent's action policy rather than simply make it observable. We provide controls for evaluating reasoning-based oversight of agents that can act or abstain.
title: Why2Speak: Faithful Reasoning for Abstaining Action Policies
title_translated: Why2Speak：关于拒绝行动策略的忠实推理
summary_translated: 许多智能体系统必须反复在执行与拒绝之间做出选择，因此忠实推理对于监督至关重要：解释只有在反映产生动作的计算过程时才有用。我们通过多角色对话中的干预时机问题来研究这一问题，其中助手需决定是否发言或保持沉默。该场景暴露了类别不平衡、不对称行动成本，以及揭示推理可能改变被审计策略的可能性。使用Qwen3-8B模型，在有或无思维链推理的情况下，我们比较了直接决策策略、推理策略、监督微调和强化学习。我们发现存在能力与可审计性之间的权衡：最强的直接策略性能更高，但不提供可检查的推理；而推理策略虽能提供行为轨迹，但性能下降，尤其是对真实干预机会的召回率降低。监督微调要么抑制推理，要么保留推理但未提升决策质量；强化学习同样未能改进推理策略。我们识别出这一失败的一个机制：在采样回放中所有选择相同动作时，群体相对目标对确信错误提示无学习信号。受控激活探测和行为消融实验表明，标准的忠实性方法可能夸大了暴露推理反映底层决策过程的证据。基于概率的指标在确信决策下趋于饱和，探测易受类别不平衡和文本泄露影响，推理消融可能混淆推理内容与推理模式的变化。综合来看，这些结果表明，暴露推理可能改变智能体的动作策略，而不仅仅是使其可观测。我们提供了用于评估可行动或拒绝的智能体之推理监督的控制方法。

summary: Enterprise adoption of large language models in finance is constrained less by fluency than by trust: in Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) and other regulated workflows, an answer is usable only if it is traceable to authoritative sources and auditable after the fact. This paper argues that retrieval-augmented generation for enterprise finance should be evaluated on auditability alongside accuracy, and presents the Knowledge-Driven Analytics Framework (KDAF), which builds ontology-driven knowledge systems through six iterative stages and retrieves evidence via Context-Aware Relevance Propagation (CARP), so that every retrieved fact carries its relationship type, confidence, and source lineage.   An evaluation on FinanceBench (145 questions) compares KDAF against zero-context inference, BM25, concept-weighted lexical retrieval, and ungrounded graph traversal. First, retrieval is necessary: zero-context inference reaches 4.1% correctness against 10-12% for retrieval-augmented conditions. Second, on answer correctness the retrieval conditions are statistically indistinguishable (KDAF vs BM25: -0.007, 95% CI [-0.021, 0.000]), so accuracy alone does not justify structured retrieval here -- a negative result we report explicitly. Third, on auditability the ordering reverses: KDAF attains the highest citation traceability F1 (0.515), exceeding ungrounded traversal by +0.027 (CI [0.006, 0.050]) and BM25 by +0.052 (CI [0.024, 0.083]), intervals excluding zero. Graph-structured retrieval also admits no evidence from outside the question subject entity (0 of 426 items, against 16.8% and 20.2% for lexical baselines), and every selected item resolves to a complete provenance chain. We argue that auditability, not accuracy, is the axis on which ontology-grounded retrieval earns its cost.
title: Auditable by Construction: An Ontology-Driven Framework for Trustworthy LLM Analytics in Enterprise Finance

title_translated: 可构建可审计性：面向企业金融可信LLM分析的本体驱动框架
summary_translated: 企业在金融领域采用大语言模型的障碍更多在于信任而非流畅性：在财务规划与分析（FP&A）及其他受监管的工作流中，答案只有在可追溯至权威来源且事后可审计时才可用。本文主张，企业金融领域的检索增强生成应与准确性一同评估可审计性，并提出知识驱动分析框架（KDAF），该框架通过六个迭代阶段构建本体驱动的知识系统，并通过上下文感知相关性传播（CARP）进行证据检索，使每个检索到的事实都携带其关系类型、置信度和来源溯源信息。在FinanceBench（145个问题）上的评估对比了KDAF与零上下文推理、BM25、概念加权词法检索及无根基图遍历。首先，检索是必要的：零上下文推理的正确率仅为4.1%，而检索增强条件达到10-12%。其次，在答案正确性方面，检索条件间统计上无显著差异（KDAF vs BM25：-0.007，95%置信区间[-0.021, 0.000]），因此仅凭准确性不足以证明结构化检索的优势——这是一个我们明确报告的负面结果。第三，在可审计性方面，排名反转：KDAF在引用可追溯性F1上达到最高值（0.515），优于无根基遍历+0.027（置信区间[0.006, 0.050]）和BM25+0.052（置信区间[0.024, 0.083]），区间均不包含零。图结构检索也无法获取问题主体实体之外的证据（426项中为0，而词法基线分别为16.8%和20.2%），且所有选中项目均能追溯完整溯源链。我们认为，可审计性而非准确性，才是本体基础检索值得付出成本的关键维度。

summary: Are frontier models able to introspect about their internal states? Recent work suggests that under certain conditions a complex enough model can audit its own internals, call out what changed, and report back confidently about it. We tested that claim on eight open-weight models from seven families and found no such ability: asked whether their own computation had been altered, none answered better than chance. To test it we built Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI), a framework that intervenes on residual-stream sites, attention heads and sparse-autoencoder features, then interrogates the model about the change against the null conditions an answer has to beat: sham runs where nothing was altered, impact-matched random perturbations, and a text-only observer that sees only the visible output.   Over 78,000 measurements, no model's report discriminates a real intervention from a sham beyond chance (AUROC ~0.5007), and an equivalence test bounds the effect below 0.15 percentage points of AUROC. Surprisingly, all the information needed is in the models. A model fine-tuned to report this class of intervention reaches near-perfect recovery on held-out directions, and a linear probe recovers intervention presence from the same activations at 75% to 95.8% accuracy, sharpening to no held-out error at the last layer before the model speaks. In one model the signal surfaces in the confidence rather than the words: its yes-or-no report never varies, while the confidence attached to it separates intervention from sham at AUROC 0.647. The failure sits in the path from internal state to verbal report, so oversight that reads a model's own testimony needs validating against an internal reference.   While our results show the inability of current open-weight models to introspect, the debate is not settled for future models.
title: Open-Weight Masked Introspection: Measuring What Language Models Can Report About Their Own Computation

title_translated: 开放权重掩码内省：测量语言模型对其自身计算的报告能力
summary_translated: 前沿模型能否对其内部状态进行内省？近期研究表明，在特定条件下，足够复杂的模型能够审计自身内部状态，指出变化之处，并自信地报告。我们在来自七个系列的八个开放权重模型上测试了这一主张，结果发现并无此类能力：当被问及自身计算是否被修改时，没有任何模型的表现优于随机猜测。为此，我们构建了开放权重掩码内省（OWMI）框架，通过干预残差流位置、注意力头和稀疏自编码器特征，然后向模型询问变化情况，并与三种对照条件进行比较：无任何修改的模拟运行、影响匹配的随机扰动，以及仅观察可见输出的文本观察者。在超过78,000次测量中，没有任何模型的报告能在真实干预与模拟运行之间实现超越随机水平的区分（AUROC ~0.5007），等效性检验将效果上限限制在AUROC的0.15个百分点以内。令人惊讶的是，所需信息实际上已存在于模型中。一个经过微调以报告此类干预的模型在保留方向上实现了近乎完美的恢复，而线性探测器在相同激活上以75%至95.8%的准确率恢复干预存在，且在模型发声前的最后一层达到无保留误差。在某一模型中，信号体现在置信度而非词汇中：其是/否报告从未变化，但附带的置信度能将干预与模拟运行区分开来（AUROC 0.647）。失败出现在从内部状态到口头报告的路径上，因此依赖模型自我证词的监督必须与内部参考进行验证。尽管我们的结果表明当前开放权重模型不具备内省能力，但未来模型的这一争论尚未终结。

summary: Formal proofs in Lean 4 that pass the kernel's type checker can nonetheless vary widely in quality. We introduce ProofJudge, an agentic LLM-as-judge system that scores formal proof quality along five dimensions beyond correctness: library leverage, automation fit, structural clarity, statement quality, and Mathlib conventions. We evaluate ProofJudge on a novel dataset of 218 declarations drawn from distinct Mathlib PRs. The judge agent is grounded by tool access to the commit the PR is applied to, enabling it to query the library state when scoring. A judge is considered aligned with human preferences when it rates the version of the PR Mathlib accepted above the initial version that was sent back for revision. All six judge models evaluated recover the reviewers' preference well above chance, from 80.8% to 63.5%, and two open-weight judges reach roughly 70% at a tenth of the best judge's cost. We release the judge harness, evaluation dataset, and evaluation traces as open-source artifacts to support further research.
title: ProofJudge: Tool-Grounded LLM Evaluation of Formal Proof Quality in Mathlib
title_translated: ProofJudge：基于工具的LLM对Mathlib中形式证明质量的评估
summary_translated: 在Lean 4中通过内核类型检查的形式证明仍可能存在质量差异。我们引入ProofJudge，一种作为裁判的智能体式LLM系统，从五个维度（除正确性外）评估形式证明质量：库利用程度、自动化契合度、结构清晰度、命题质量以及Mathlib规范。我们在一个从不同Mathlib PR中提取的218个声明的新数据集上评估ProofJudge。该裁判智能体通过访问PR所应用的提交版本获得工具支持，从而在评分时查询库状态。当裁判认为被接受的PR版本高于最初退回修订的版本时，即视为与人类偏好对齐。所有六种裁判模型的表现均远超随机水平，准确率从80.8%到63.5%不等，其中两个开放权重裁判在成本仅为最佳裁判十分之一的情况下达到约70%的准确率。我们公开发布裁判框架、评估数据集和评估轨迹，以支持进一步研究。

summary: Agentic memory under a fixed budget involves two stages: retention and retrieval. Existing retrieval-centered paradigms implicitly assume necessary evidence survives eviction, but we challenge this by isolating a pre-retrieval failure mode: structurally indirect prerequisite eviction, in which upstream blocks weakly aligned with the query are discarded under budget pressure. We provide an operational definition of this failure, a reproducible deterministic benchmark, and per-seed trace diagnostics. Finally, we evaluate Dependency-aware Semantic Garbage Collection (DSGC), a one-hop graph-aware rule. In our main suite, DSGC improves full-chain retention from 0.03 to 0.90 under a lexical encoder and from 0.23 to 1.00 under a sentence encoder. Robustness checks then identify the budget and scaling regimes where the one-hop rule holds or degrades. Our released pipeline and failure postmortem support mechanistic analysis of retention before retrieval as a distinct failure boundary.
title: When Retrieval Fails Before It Begins: Structurally Indirect Prerequisite Eviction as a Retention Failure in Agentic Memory

title_translated: 检索尚未开始便已失败：结构间接前提淘汰作为智能体记忆中的保留失败
summary_translated: 在固定预算下的智能体记忆包含两个阶段：保留与检索。现有的以检索为中心的范式隐含假设必要证据在淘汰过程中得以留存，但我们通过分离出一种预检索失败模式——结构间接前提淘汰，对此提出质疑：在预算压力下，与查询弱对齐的上游模块被丢弃。我们提出了该失败的可操作定义、可复现的确定性基准以及基于种子的追踪诊断方法。最后，我们评估了一种单跳图感知规则——依赖感知语义垃圾回收（DSGC）。在主实验套件中，DSGC在词法编码器下将完整链路保留率从0.03提升至0.90，在句子编码器下从0.23提升至1.00。鲁棒性检验进一步识别出该单跳规则成立或退化的预算与缩放区间。我们发布的流程和失败后分析支持对检索前保留机制的机制性分析，将其视为一个独立的失败边界。

summary: Industry pipelines that turn speech into supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data via multi-stage refinement are increasingly adopted but, to our knowledge, have not been publicly ablated stage-by-stage, leaving each stage's marginal value unknown. We design a production-ready speech-to-SFT pipeline in which transcript refinement (Phase 0) and SFT data quality refinement (Phase 2) are independently toggleable, yielding a 2x2 factorial design. For each condition, we generate QA-form SFT data from Korean medical and finance conference recordings and fine-tune 9 models (5 LLM families, 2.4B-70B); we evaluate with four cross-provider LLM judges, a blind six-expert human evaluation, and 3 downstream MCQA benchmarks. Our central finding: under a fixed, standard SFT recipe, improvements in QA data quality do not transfer uniformly into downstream MCQA gains. 4-judge quality rises consistently, yet the cross-model mean MCQA gain is not significant; positive transfer concentrates on family-domain aligned pairs. This differential pattern is consistent with a format mismatch: Phase 2 shifts SFT-data composition toward explanatory items, while MCQA primarily probes factoid recall. All six human raters report higher full-pipeline quality, confirming the LLM-judge direction. An STT-engine swap to Whisper-medium confirms pipeline robustness. A non-hallucination audit shows the two frontier LLMs admit unknown on approximately 8% of QA on average; we release samples, prompts, code, and all SFT checkpoints.
title: A Factorial Ablation of a Speech-to-SFT Pipeline: Differential Effects on Data Quality and Downstream Transfer
title_translated: 语音到SFT流水线的因子消融研究：对数据质量和下游迁移的差异性影响
summary_translated: 业界越来越多地采用多阶段精炼的语音转监督微调（SFT）数据流水线，但据我们所知，尚未有公开的逐阶段消融研究，导致各阶段的边际价值尚不明确。我们设计了一个可投入生产的语音转SFT流水线，其中转录精炼（阶段0）和SFT数据质量精炼（阶段2）可独立开关，形成2×2因子设计。针对每种条件，我们从韩语医疗与金融会议录音中生成QA格式的SFT数据，并微调9个模型（5个LLM家族，规模2.4B-70B）；评估采用四位跨供应商LLM评委、盲评六位专家人工评估以及三个下游MCQA基准。核心发现：在固定标准SFT配方下，QA数据质量的提升并未均匀转化为下游MCQA性能的增益。四名评委对质量的评分持续上升，但跨模型平均MCQA增益并不显著；正向迁移集中于家族-领域对齐的组合。这一差异模式与格式不匹配一致：阶段2使SFT数据组成更偏向解释性内容，而MCQA主要考察事实性回忆。所有六位人工评估者均报告全流水线质量更高，验证了LLM评委的方向。将STT引擎替换为Whisper-medium也证实了流水线的鲁棒性。非幻觉审计显示，两个前沿LLM在约8%的QA上承认未知；我们已发布样本、提示、代码及所有SFT检查点。
